spans.s:
1 क्षि क्षे॑ति क्षिय॑ति क्ष॑यति abide, dwell, inhabit;
rule, be master of (gen.). C. क्षय॑यति & क्षेपयति pacify. — अधि
dwell in, rest on, spread over (acc. or loc.). आ dwell in, inhabit, be
or become possessed of (acc.), exist. उप dwell in or near, remain
with, rest or depend on (acc.), परि dwell about (acc.). प्रति
settle at (acc). सम् dwell together with (instr.).

क्षित् a. & s. dwelling, ruling;
 inhabitant, ruler.
क्षितितल n. the surface of the earth.

क्षितिधरगुरु m. the master of the mountains i.e.
the Himalaya.
क्षितिभृत् m. a mountain or king.
क्षितिरस m. the sap or juice of the earth.
क्षिप्रनिश्चय a. quick of resolution, resolute.
क्षीणवृत्ति a. whose means of subsistence are exhausted.
क्षीणायुस् a. whose life is (nearly) ended.
क्षीरक्षय m. the diminution of milk (in the udder).

क्षीरप a. drinking milk;
 m. a suckling baby, infant.

क्षीरवृक्ष m. milk-tree^1 (E of sev. kinds of fig.).
[1] Correction submitted by AnnaRybakovaT, Jim Funderburk. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/25.
क्षीरस्निग्ध a. wet with milky juice.
क्षीरस्वामिन् m. N. of a grammarian.

क्षीरि॑न् a. milky, yielding milk;
 m. N. of sev. plants.
